versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.

- Version 1.0.2 was released with no file changes compared to the previous release.
- All features, documentation, and APIs remain identical to the previous version.

flexarm-skill 1.0.1

- Rewrote the description and added a new section specifying exactly when AI agents must use this skill, including clear usage and non-usage scenarios.
- Emphasized intended use cases (physical smartphone interaction via robot arm and camera) with concrete examples and triggers.
- Clarified that this skill is for real device interaction only, not for virtual or simulated devices.
- Made the AI agent's usage criteria more discoverable for all users.
- No code or API changes; documentation and guidance update only.

FlexArm Robot Controller 2.0.1 — Major upgrade with expanded robot arm phone control APIs.

- Added detailed documentation and setup instructions, including calibration, fixed-port service, and usage caveats.
- Greatly expanded API coverage to 54 endpoints for robot control, camera vision, template and text detection, and YAML automation scripting.
- Now supports actions like precise clicking, swiping, multi-icon operations, OCR, and complex script orchestration.
- Clarified requirements for proper UTF-8 handling and command-line usage (Python requests recommended for Chinese text).
- Expanded system management, configuration, and script control APIs for full automation workflow integration.
